settings.heading: Plans change. Here's how cancellations work.
settings.subheading: Free of charge until your pair is handed to the courier.

settings.title: Order confirmation
settings.text: We confirm your order by call or WhatsApp. You can cancel free of charge.

settings.title: Payment verification
settings.text: We check your Care deposit or advance payment. You can still cancel free, and it is refunded in full.

settings.title: Dispatch
settings.text: Once the parcel is with the courier, it cannot be cancelled.

settings.title: Delivery
settings.text: If you no longer want the pair, our exchange and return terms apply once it is delivered.

settings.title: Before dispatch
settings.body: You can cancel any order free of charge until it is handed to the courier. Reply to your confirmation message on WhatsApp or call +92 319 9628735 with your order number.

settings.title: After advance payment
settings.body: If you paid in advance or sent a Care deposit and cancel before dispatch, we refund it in full to the account you paid from.

settings.title: After dispatch
settings.body: Once a parcel is with the courier it cannot be cancelled. If you no longer want the pair, our exchange and return terms apply once it is delivered.

settings.title: Failed delivery
settings.body: If you will not be available, reply to the WhatsApp confirmation and we will reschedule. If a parcel comes back to us because it could not be delivered, we message you on WhatsApp to arrange a new delivery, and we agree with you what happens to the order and your Care deposit before anything is cancelled.

settings.title: Refused parcels
settings.body: Please do not refuse a confirmed parcel at the door. It costs two courier legs.

settings.title: Cancellation by DAUR
settings.body: We may cancel an order if stock runs out, the details cannot be confirmed or the price shown was clearly wrong. If that happens you pay nothing, and any advance payment is refunded in full.

settings.title: Refund process
settings.body: Refunds go back in full to the account you paid from, within 3 working days of the cancellation being confirmed.

settings.heading: Need to cancel?
settings.text: Reply to your confirmation on WhatsApp or call +92 319 9628735 with your order number.
